suppressions.reason: Accepted mirror per plan 4 Phase 22.1: resolveScipBinaryCachePath() intentionally duplicates src/tla/tool-runner.ts's resolveTlaToolsJarCachePath() (same $SCIP_QUERY_CACHE_DIR/$XDG_CACHE_HOME/~/.cache/scip-query resolution, different filename). Both call sites are well under 30 lines, so the plan's reuse audit considered extracting a shared fetchVerifiedBinary/cache-dir helper -- but the only shared location either side could import from (src/core/) is not reachable from either layer: layerPolicyForEdge in src/queries/cleanup/drift-policy.ts allows neither runtime->core nor tla->core today, and adding a runtime<->tla edge is explicitly Phase 24.4's job, not 22.1's. Mirroring is the plan's stated fallback when extraction isn't reachable.

Accepted mirror per plan 4 Phase 22.1: scip-cli.ts's sha256() intentionally duplicates src/tla/tool-runner.ts's sha256() (same createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex') one-liner). Same layer-policy blocker as SQ90611099482C -- see that entry for the full reuse-audit reasoning.

Accepted mirror per plan 4 Phase 22.1: same sha256() duplication as SQB959866D7736, flagged again as a twin pair because both copies are new-ish. See SQ90611099482C for the layer-policy reasoning that rules out extraction this phase.

Accepted trivial-helper echo: ledgerKey() is a 1-line "join two strings with a NUL separator into a map key" helper. The repo already has 5+ independent versions of this exact pattern per-domain (symbolNoiseFor, sourceFingerprintDefinitionKey, fileLeafKey, ...); extracting one shared helper across unrelated modules is a separate cross-cutting refactor out of scope for remediation plan 3.

Accepted: evidence-cache.ts and docs/benchmarks/2026-06-28-vega-current-scoreboard.md are both members of the pre-existing "2026-06-28 optimization evidence ledger" declaredCoupling group. The scoreboard doc is a dated snapshot (matches docs.snapshotPaths); co-change-partner does not yet apply the snapshot-doc policy the way doc-reference/doc-drift do (18.2 scoped that exemption to those two checks only) — extending it to co-change-partner is a reasonable follow-up but out of scope here.

trailingResolutionRate() is exported pure API consumed by tests/queries/health/finding-outcome-ledger.test.ts; tests are not SCIP-indexed so exported test-only helpers always trip new-dead (same precedent as knownSrcLayers in cc71f38). Kept exported and separately testable per the Testability Design table in the remediation plan.

False-positive echo: normalizeBody's stripCommentsAndStrings treats the escaped-slash-then-regex-close sequence in /^\.\// as a // line comment, so everything after it on the line (including this function's extra trailing-slash strip) is masked away before hashing. This function is not actually identical to normalizeRelativePath/normalizeProjectPath (already a pre-existing echo pair before this diff) — it additionally strips trailing slashes. Fixing the underlying comment-vs-regex-literal ambiguity in stripCommentsAndStrings is out of scope for this change (shared by many detectors, high blast radius).
